underground.limestone-drip-cave.name: Limestone Drip Cave
underground.limestone-drip-cave.description: Solution cave with rounded limestone walls and selective speleothems.

underground.basalt-lava-tube.name: Basalt Lava Tube
underground.basalt-lava-tube.description: Volcanic tunnel left by drained lava, with dark smooth-to-ropy rock forms and occasional collapse openings.

underground.talus-boulder-cave.name: Talus Boulder Cave
underground.talus-boulder-cave.description: Irregular voids between large fallen angular boulders with tight squeezes and broken sightlines.

underground.sea-cave.name: Wave-Cut Sea Cave
underground.sea-cave.description: Coastal cave eroded along fractures by waves, with a wet rock floor and visible ocean connection.

underground.underground-river-cavern.name: Underground River Cavern
underground.underground-river-cavern.description: Large natural chamber shaped around a flowing subterranean river.

underground.crystal-cavern.name: Crystal Cavern
underground.crystal-cavern.description: Natural chamber punctuated by a limited number of large crystalline growths.

underground.fungal-cavern.name: Fungal Cavern
underground.fungal-cavern.description: Damp cave chamber dominated by a few large mushroom and shelf-fungus forms.

underground.mine-tunnel.name: Abandoned Mine Tunnel
underground.mine-tunnel.description: Excavated rock passage supported by rough timber and practical mining remains.

underground.dressed-stone-corridor.name: Dressed-Stone Corridor
underground.dressed-stone-corridor.description: Purpose-built dungeon passage of fitted blocks and flagstones.

underground.trapped-stone-corridor.name: Trapped Stone Corridor
underground.trapped-stone-corridor.description: Built passage whose architecture visibly supports hazards and trap mechanisms.

underground.barracks-passage.name: Underground Barracks Passage
underground.barracks-passage.description: Fortified corridor widened for guards, drills, and stored military equipment.

underground.catacomb-niches.name: Catacomb Niche Hall
underground.catacomb-niches.description: Burial passage lined with large wall niches, stone coffins, or bone repositories.

underground.cistern.name: Dungeon Cistern
underground.cistern.description: Stone water-storage chamber with channels, grates, and damp masonry.

underground.rotunda.name: Dungeon Rotunda
underground.rotunda.description: Circular built chamber organized around a central pillar, well, statue, or floor motif.

underground.crypt.name: Stone Crypt
underground.crypt.description: Burial chamber with substantial tomb architecture and restrained funerary decoration.

underground.armory.name: Abandoned Armory
underground.armory.description: Dungeon storage area for weapons and armor with practical racks and ruined metal.

underground.refuse-pit.name: Refuse Pit
underground.refuse-pit.description: Sunken waste area beneath a dungeon with large discarded objects and organic debris kept visually simple.

underground.webbed-chapel.name: Webbed Underground Chapel
underground.webbed-chapel.description: Small subterranean sacred space partly abandoned and overtaken by webs.

underground.rough-stone-pantry.name: Rough Stone Pantry
underground.rough-stone-pantry.description: Underground food store with crude shelves, sacks, crocks, and hanging provisions rather than modern cabinetry.

underground.throne-grotto.name: Improvised Throne Grotto
underground.throne-grotto.description: Natural cave chamber turned into a crude audience space with scavenged furniture and trophies.

underground.war-room.name: Cave War Room
underground.war-room.description: Natural chamber adapted for military planning with a central table and practical gear.
visual_cues: single tunnel map or marker board

underground.spiral-stair.name: Cramped Spiral Stair
underground.spiral-stair.description: Tight masonry stair curling around a central newel or shaft, emphasizing vertical confinement.

underground.prison-cell.name: Dungeon Prison Cell
underground.prison-cell.description: Small barred cell with heavy masonry and only a few functional objects.

underground.well-shaft.name: Vertical Well Shaft
underground.well-shaft.description: Deep circular stone shaft with strong vertical perspective and a visible rim or ledge.

underground.floor-grate.name: Floor-Grate Passage
underground.floor-grate.description: Built corridor section organized around a large drain or grate opening.

underground.webbed-hall.name: Webbed Dungeon Hall
underground.webbed-hall.description: Built hall overtaken by a few broad web sheets anchored to arches and corners.
visual_cues: two or three large web spans

underground.treasure-vault.name: Treasure Vault
underground.treasure-vault.description: Secure chamber with a small number of large treasure containers and masonry security features.
visual_cues: one broad coin or object pile

underground.display-gallery.name: Dungeon Display Gallery
underground.display-gallery.description: Formal passage or room with pedestals, statues, or armor displays spaced clearly apart.

underground.labyrinth.name: Stone Labyrinth
underground.labyrinth.description: Maze of repeating masonry passages distinguished by turns, intersections, and scale rather than decorative clutter.
must_avoid: same straight corridor framing on every page

underground.antechamber.name: Dungeon Antechamber
underground.antechamber.description: Small transitional chamber with one or two architectural features indicating entry to a more important room.

underground.collapsed-tunnel.name: Collapsed Tunnel
underground.collapsed-tunnel.description: Damaged passage with a few massive rubble blocks and a restricted opening.
visual_cues: dust or loose earth shown sparingly

underground.earthen-burrow.name: Earthen Burrow
underground.earthen-burrow.description: Excavated soil tunnel with packed walls, root intrusions, and a rough floor.

underground.loose-earth-cavern.name: Loose-Earth Cavern
underground.loose-earth-cavern.description: Natural chamber with deep soil, eroded banks, and exposed rock, suitable for burrowing creatures.

underground.stone-gallery.name: Underground Stone Gallery
underground.stone-gallery.description: Long masonry chamber with large statues or wall bays and clear walking space.
visual_cues: two or three large statues or plinths

underground.crude-henhouse.name: Improvised Dungeon Henhouse
underground.crude-henhouse.description: Crude underground animal pen built from rough boards, wire-free slats, straw, and stone walls.

underground.phylactery-vault.name: Deep Phylactery Vault
underground.phylactery-vault.description: Secure arcane burial chamber built around a single protected relic and monumental stone architecture.

underground.mushroom-hall.name: Underground Mushroom Hall
underground.mushroom-hall.description: Broad damp chamber with a small number of oversized mushroom forms and open floor lanes.
visual_cues: three or four large mushroom caps

underground.mine-shaft.name: Deep Mine Shaft
underground.mine-shaft.description: Large excavated vertical or sloping mine passage reinforced by timber and dominated by depth.

underground.service-crawlway.name: Low Dungeon Service Crawlway
underground.service-crawlway.description: A cramped purpose-built dungeon service passage with unmistakable stone construction, low overhead clearance, and practical utility fittings.

identity.material_language: rough-cut dressed stone block walls, broad flagstone floor slabs, and a heavy timber or stone lintel ceiling
identity_markers: iron wall torch sconce or empty iron bracket
narrow service niche, barred utility opening, or drain recess
identity.spatial_read: the ceiling is visibly low, the walls are narrow, and corridor perspective makes the passage read as part of a dungeon rather than a generic hallway

visual_cues: visibly low stone or timber ceiling
colorable_forms: one large ceiling beam or lintel
one or two simple iron fixtures

underground.stone-stair.name: Dungeon Stone Stair
underground.stone-stair.description: A practical built stairway with heavy stone treads, tight walls, and clear vertical movement.

underground.fortified-gate.name: Fortified Dungeon Gate
underground.fortified-gate.description: Defensive underground threshold with heavy stonework and a few large gate elements.
visual_cues: heavy gate leaves or portcullis bars

underground.collapsed-ceiling-hall.name: Collapsed-Ceiling Hall
underground.collapsed-ceiling-hall.description: A built masonry hall damaged by overhead collapse, leaving a large breach, fallen blocks, and an ambush opening above.
